types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AffiliateShare
types.doc:
AffiliateShare credits one affiliate vault, a sub-account the broker owns,
 with a fee charged on top of the service and broker fees.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of an active affiliate vault of the broker
 (QuickSwapBrokerService.CreateAffiliateVault). Create the vault first: an
 unknown, disabled or other broker's vault, or the default vault, fails
 with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: bps
fields.doc: Fee in basis points of what each leg receives, from 1 to 300.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AffiliateVault
types.doc:
AffiliateVault is a sub-account of the broker root, owned by the broker,
 credited with the fees of one affiliate. Affiliate vaults are never
 deleted.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the vault; name it in AffiliateShare.account_id.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Broker-chosen label, unique per broker.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Whether new QuickSwaps can name the vault.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the vault was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the vault was last changed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AssetVolume
types.doc: AssetVolume is a total amount in one asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Total, in base units of 18 decimals.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.AssetWithoutDestination
types.doc:
AssetWithoutDestination is an asset a vault holds or was ever credited
 in, which its rule pays no destination for, so no run pays it out.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: balance
fields.doc:
The vault's settled balance of the asset now, as ListVaultBalances
 reports it, in base units of 18 decimals; zero when everything it was
 credited has left the vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Broker
types.doc: Broker is a broker org.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Broker name: the immutable identifier used in every request.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: Display name.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc:
Whether the broker may quote and create QuickSwaps. A disabled broker
 keeps reads, vaults, keys and members.

fields.name: root_account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the broker's root account.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: default_vault_account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the default vault, credited with broker fees
 that name no affiliate.

fields.name: max_affiliate_vaults
fields.doc:
Affiliate vaults the broker may create, active and disabled together.
 At the limit, CreateAffiliateVault fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED /
 BROKER_LIMIT.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: The caller's role; BROKER_ROLE_UNSPECIFIED for a broker API key.

fields.name: quote_rps
fields.doc:
Quote requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which
 is also the burst. Over the rate, QuoteQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: create_rps
fields.doc:
Create requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which
 is also the burst. Over the rate, CreateQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: read_rps
fields.doc:
Read requests per second allowed for each API key of the broker, which is
 also the burst. GetQuickSwap and every QuickSwapBrokerService call by an
 API key count as reads. Over the rate, the call fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT and a Retry-After header.

fields.name: max_unfunded_addresses
fields.doc:
Unfunded Quick Swaps the broker may hold at once: Quick Swaps whose
 deposit address is being issued or is still awaiting a deposit within
 its funding window. At the limit, CreateQuickSwap fails with
 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT; a deposit or the end of a funding
 window frees a slot.

fields.name: max_creates_per_hour
fields.doc:
Quick Swaps the broker may create in any rolling hour. At the limit,
 CreateQuickSwap fails with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED / BROKER_LIMIT until the
 oldest create of the hour is more than an hour old.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerKey
types.doc: BrokerKey is a broker API key, without its secret.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Public key ID: the part of the token between "qsk_" and the second "_".

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Label given at creation; empty for a key created by rotation.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the key was created.

fields.name: created_by_account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the member who created the key; 0 for a key that a
 key created by rotating itself.

fields.name: rotated_from
fields.doc: Key this key replaced by rotation; empty otherwise.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the key's rotation overlap; the key stops working then. Unset
 while the key works until revoked.

fields.name: revoked_at
fields.doc: When the key was revoked; unset while not revoked.

fields.name: active
fields.doc: Whether the key works now: neither revoked nor past expires_at.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerRole
types.doc:
BrokerRole is a person's role in a broker org. A broker has exactly one
 Owner.

values.name: OWNER
values.doc:
Everything, including withdrawals, payout settings and transferring
 ownership. Exactly one per broker.

values.name: ADMIN
values.doc:
Everything except withdrawals, payout settings, changing the Owner and
 transferring ownership: only the Owner and Finance withdraw or change
 payout settings.

values.name: FINANCE
values.doc: Internal transfers, withdrawals and payout settings.

values.name: AFFILIATE_MANAGER
values.doc: Creates affiliate vaults and views balances.

values.name: VIEWER
values.doc: Read-only.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerStatsPeriod
types.doc:
BrokerStatsPeriod is a broker's QuickSwap activity in one UTC day or
 month. A QuickSwap counts in the period it was created in, with its
 current status, its credited deposit and its destination payout, so a
 period's numbers keep moving until its QuickSwaps end. A fee counts in the
 period it was charged in, as in GetFeeTotals, which can be later than the
 period its QuickSwap was created in.

fields.name: period_start
fields.doc: Start of the UTC day or month.

fields.name: created_count
fields.doc: QuickSwaps created in the period, inside the window.

fields.name: statuses
fields.doc:
Those QuickSwaps by current status, in QuickSwapStatus number order;
 statuses with none are omitted. The counts total created_count.

fields.name: deposited
fields.doc:
Deposits credited to those QuickSwaps and taken in for execution, per
 asset, in asset_id order: including a deposit later found ineligible
 and returned, excluding a deposit held for review before credit.

fields.name: delivered
fields.doc:
Paid to the destination of those QuickSwaps whose DESTINATION
 withdrawal is FINALIZED, per asset, in asset_id order: after service,
 broker and affiliate fees, before the destination network fee.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Fees charged to the broker's QuickSwaps in the period, per asset, in
 asset_id order. broker_fee plus affiliate_fee equals the GetFeeTotals
 total of the same window, period and asset.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.BrokerUsage
types.doc:
BrokerUsage is the broker's current use of its limits, counted exactly as
 the limits are enforced: the next create is refused while a count is at or
 above its limit on Broker. A count can be above its limit after the limit
 is lowered. The counts are read when the request is served and can change
 right after with concurrent creates, deposits and expiring funding windows.

fields.name: unfunded_addresses
fields.doc:
Unfunded Quick Swaps held now, counted against
 Broker.max_unfunded_addresses.

fields.name: creates_last_hour
fields.doc:
Quick Swaps created in the last hour, counted against
 Broker.max_creates_per_hour.

fields.name: affiliate_vaults
fields.doc:
Affiliate vaults created, active and disabled together, counted against
 Broker.max_affiliate_vaults.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ChargedFee
types.doc:
ChargedFee is what one vault has been credited with for a QuickSwap in
 one asset, from settled fills and bridge payouts.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: BROKER, AFFILIATE or REFERRAL.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the credited vault: the default vault for
 BROKER, the affiliate vault for AFFILIATE; zero for REFERRAL.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount credited, in base units of 18 decimals.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeRequest
types.doc: CheckReferralCodeRequest asks whether the caller may take a code.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The code; letters are compared case-insensitively.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CheckReferralCodeResponse
types.doc:
CheckReferralCodeResponse answers for the code. The answer can change
 before SetReferralCode if another partner takes the code first.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The code in lower case; empty when it is CODE_INVALID.

fields.name: availability
fields.doc: Whether the caller may take it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultRequest
types.doc:
CreateAffiliateVaultRequest creates, or returns, the affiliate vault with a
 label.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: label
fields.doc:
Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace, unique
 per broker. The same label always returns the same vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateAffiliateVaultResponse
types.doc: CreateAffiliateVaultResponse returns the vault.

fields.name: vault
fields.doc: The vault.

fields.name: created
fields.doc: Whether this request created it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyRequest
types.doc: CreateKeyRequest creates a broker API key.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: Label, 1 to 64 characters without leading or trailing whitespace.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateKeyResponse
types.doc:
CreateKeyResponse returns the key and its token. The token is shown only
 here and cannot be recovered.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The key.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Bearer token qsk_<key id>_<secret>. Store it as a server secret.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapRequest
types.doc:
CreateQuickSwapRequest creates, or returns, the QuickSwap for one
 idempotency key.

cel.message: refund_zipped_asset_id and refund_address must be set together, and refund_memo requires refund_address

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc:
Broker-chosen idempotency key, 1 to 128 characters of letters, digits,
 '.', '_', ':' or '-'. Scoped to the authenticated broker and retained
 permanently. The same key with the same request returns the same QuickSwap
 and deposit address; with a different request it fails with
 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Requests are compared after every valid address and
 memo is put in its network's canonical form, so the same address in
 another case or encoding is the same request; affiliate order is
 ignored; every other field, the fees included, must be equal.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Economic terms.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network, in its native
 text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: destination_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for destination_address. Required when the
 destination network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when
 unsupported. See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: return_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of returned source funds on the source network, in its native
 text form without memo: 1-256 UTF-8 bytes. Deposits that are not
 accepted, and source funds that are not traded, go here; never to an
 observed sender.

fields.name: return_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for return_address. Required when the source
 network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported.
 See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: refund_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Refund route for the intermediate asset of a two-leg route: an
 AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id of the asset whose AssetConfig.ledger_id
 is the quote's intermediate_asset_id in GET
 /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config, for example USDT on Ethereum. Required
 with refund_address when the route has an intermediate asset; optional
 and unused otherwise.

fields.name: refund_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of refunded intermediate asset on the refund route's network,
 in its native text form without memo. At most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: refund_memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo for refund_address. Required when the refund
 network requires one, optional when supported, and empty when unsupported.
 See ChainConfig.memo_requirement. At most 128 UTF-8 bytes.

fields.name: source_wallet
fields.doc:
Optional source wallet the end user will deposit from, for brokers that
 know it in advance. It must be a valid address on the source network, at
 most 256 UTF-8 bytes, and is shown on the QuickSwap.

fields.name: affiliates
fields.doc:
Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault:
 at most three distinct vaults. Fixed at creation with broker_bps.

fields.name: broker_bps
fields.doc:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of
 the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none.
 broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300. Fees outside these
 rules fail with FEES_INVALID.

fields.name: referral_code
fields.doc:
Optional referral partner code from a referral link, case-insensitive,
 at most 64 bytes; empty for none. Only a broker with a referral program may send one
 (REFERRAL_NOT_SUPPORTED otherwise), never with affiliates (FEES_INVALID).
 It must be a valid code (REFERRAL_CODE_INVALID) that is a partner's
 current code (REFERRAL_CODE_UNKNOWN), and the partner must be active
 (REFERRAL_PARTNER_INACTIVE). The program's rates
 for the route are applied (quote.referral) and fixed at creation. It is
 part of the request: the same idempotency_key with another code, or with
 and without one, is IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.CreateQuickSwapResponse
types.doc: CreateQuickSwapResponse returns the QuickSwap bound to the idempotency key.

fields.name: quick_swap
fields.doc:
The QuickSwap, normally AWAITING_DEPOSIT with deposit_instructions. A
 retry returns its current state with the original quote and address.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Deposit
types.doc: Deposit is one deposit detected on the QuickSwap's deposit address.

fields.name: index
fields.doc: Zero-based position in detection order; stable for the QuickSwap's life.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc: Source-network transaction identifier in the network's native text form.

fields.name: tx_occurrence_index
fields.doc: Output or log index of the deposit within tx_hash; zero is valid.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset and network actually received, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero until
 Polyester has identified the deposit's asset, shortly after detection,
 and when the asset is not a supported route.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Received amount, before the deposit network fee, in zipped_asset_id's
 token units; unset while zipped_asset_id is zero.

fields.name: disposition
fields.doc: What this deposit may do.

fields.name: reason
confirmations
fields.doc:
Current source-network confirmations; zero until the source network
 reports any. Never decreases.

fields.name: required_confirmations
fields.doc: Source-network confirmations required before credit; zero until known.

fields.name: detected_at
fields.doc:
When the deposit was first seen. Eligibility compares this time with
 funding_expires_at.

fields.name: credited_at
fields.doc:
When the deposit was credited; unset until credited. Credit does not
 decide eligibility: a credited deposit can still be EVALUATING, and one
 then found ineligible, such as a late deposit, stays credited and is
 returned (RETURN_ONLY).

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc:
Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this deposit, usable with
 GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. Lifecycle flow
 amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base units.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositAddressState
types.doc: DepositAddressState is the lifecycle state of a QuickSwap deposit address.

values.name: ACTIVE
values.doc: The address accepts the first eligible deposit.

values.name: REFUND_MODE
values.doc:
Entered on the first confirmed deposit. Any further deposit is returned
 or held and never executes. Ends at address_retires_at. An address that
 expires unfunded goes from ACTIVE straight to RETIRED.

values.name: RETIRED
values.doc:
The address is retired. A deposit sent to it is not processed
 automatically; it is handled only through support-assisted recovery, and
 recovery is not guaranteed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositDisposition
types.doc: DepositDisposition is what a detected deposit is allowed to do.

values.name: EVALUATING
values.doc:
Detected; eligibility is being evaluated. A deposit can already be
 credited (credited_at) while it is evaluated.

values.name: ELIGIBLE
values.doc:
The eligible deposit that confirmed first. It consumed the QuickSwap and
 is the only deposit that can execute.

values.name: RETURN_ONLY
values.doc:
Not accepted: it is returned to return_address and never executes. A
 deposit found ineligible after it was credited, such as a late deposit
 (LATE_DEPOSIT), one below min_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM) or
 above max_deposit_amount (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM), or one of the wrong
 asset or network (WRONG_ASSET), keeps credited_at and is returned from its
 credit.

values.name: ON_HOLD
values.doc:
Held for review; it neither executes nor returns until released. A
 deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) keeps this
 disposition after Zipper's compliance team transferred its funds out
 (QuickSwap CLOSED).

values.name: MANUAL_RECOVERY
values.doc:
Observed on an address that was already retired (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED).
 It never executes and is not returned automatically. It is handled only
 through support-assisted recovery, and it is potentially unrecoverable.
 The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.DepositInstructions
types.doc: DepositInstructions tell the end user where and until when to deposit.

fields.name: address
fields.doc: Deposit address in the source network's native text form, without memo.

fields.name: memo
fields.doc:
Destination tag or memo the deposit must carry; empty when the source
 network uses none. A deposit without it cannot be attributed.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset and network to deposit; equal to terms.source_zipped_asset_id.

fields.name: issued_at
fields.doc:
When the address was issued to this QuickSwap; the funding window starts
 here. After ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE it can be long after created_at.

fields.name: funding_expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the funding window, fixed when the address is issued (currently 7
 days after issued_at). A deposit can execute only if Polyester detects it
 before this time; detection time counts, not block time, and
 confirmations may finish later. A deposit detected at or after this time
 never executes. A deposit observed on a retired address is
 MANUAL_RECOVERY and is not returned automatically; other late deposits
 are RETURN_ONLY. For an unfunded address, address_retires_at equals this
 time, so there is no separate scheduled return period. Send deposits well
 before this time. Never changes.

fields.name: address_retires_at
fields.doc:
After this time the deposit address is retired and funds sent to it may
 not be recoverable. For an unfunded address it equals funding_expires_at.
 After a deposit is accepted it is provisional, a lower bound, until
 Polyester releases the deposit address, which can be shortly after the
 QuickSwap becomes terminal; from then on it is at least 7 days after all
 payouts finish. It only moves later, never earlier, and never before
 funding_expires_at.

fields.name: address_state
fields.doc: Current lifecycle state of the address.

fields.name: min_native_gas_limit
fields.doc:
Recommended gas limit, in gas units, for native-coin deposits on EVM
 networks: 250000. Polyester does not enforce this limit. On some networks,
 depositing to an address that has never received funds requires far more
 than 21000 gas. If the limit is too low, the transaction fails on chain
 without depositing funds, and the network fee is still charged. Use at
 least the recommended limit. Unused gas is not charged. Zero for token
 deposits and non-EVM networks.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerRequest
types.doc: EnrollReferralPartnerRequest applies to become a referral partner.

fields.name: earnings_subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of an active sub-account the caller owns, to be
 credited with the commissions. It cannot be changed later or be used by
 another partner.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc:
Name shown for the partner, 1 to 64 characters without leading or
 trailing spaces.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.EnrollReferralPartnerResponse
types.doc:
EnrollReferralPartnerResponse returns the new partner, pending review, with
 a random 8-character code.

fields.name: partner
fields.doc: The partner.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc: ErrorCode is the stable machine-readable QuickSwap error code.

values.name: ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
The source and destination route is not offered, or a bridge was
 requested with TWAP execution.

values.name: AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE
values.doc:
The amount is outside the route's current limits. The error carries the
 limits (min_deposit_amount, max_deposit_amount) when known.

values.name: DECIMALS_MISMATCH
values.doc: An amount's decimals do not match its route's token decimals.

values.name: DESTINATION_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc:
destination_address or destination_memo is not valid on the destination
 network.

values.name: RETURN_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc: return_address or return_memo is not valid on the source network.

values.name: REFUND_ADDRESS_REQUIRED
values.doc: The route has an intermediate asset and no refund address was supplied.

values.name: REFUND_ADDRESS_INVALID
values.doc:
refund_zipped_asset_id is not a withdraw route of the intermediate asset,
 or refund_address or refund_memo is not valid on its network.

values.name: SOURCE_WALLET_INVALID
values.doc: source_wallet is not valid on the source network.

values.name: QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: No price is currently available for the route; retry later.

values.name: PROTECTION_UNACHIEVABLE
values.doc:
The protection cannot be met at the current price: a min_amount_out above
 the expected output, or an order book that cannot fill the protected
 execution at the quoted prices.

values.name: ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
No deposit address is available right now. The QuickSwap (swap_id in the
 error) is kept, and its address is allocated automatically when one frees
 up. Follow it with GetQuickSwap or by repeating the request unchanged. Its
 quote stays the one priced at creation, and its funding window starts
 when the address is issued (issued_at).

values.name: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT
values.doc: The idempotency key was already used with a different request.

values.name: SWAP_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
No QuickSwap of this broker matches the selector; on
 QuickSwapReferralService, no QuickSwap the caller referred.

values.name: BROKER_DISABLED
values.doc:
The broker is disabled: quotes and creates are refused. Reads and
 QuickSwaps already created continue.

values.name: BROKER_LIMIT
values.doc:
A broker limit was reached: the unfunded QuickSwaps held at once, the
 QuickSwaps created per hour, the request rate of the API key, or the
 affiliate vaults the broker may create. Nothing is bound to the key. A
 funded or expired QuickSwap frees an unfunded slot; when the response
 carries a Retry-After header, retry after that many seconds.

values.name: AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN
values.doc:
An affiliate names a vault that is not an active affiliate vault of the
 broker: unknown, not yet created, disabled, another broker's, or the
 default vault. Nothing is bound to the key; create or enable the vault
 and repeat the request.

values.name: BROKER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No broker with this name has the caller as its key or member.

values.name: ACTION_DENIED
values.doc: The caller's role, or a broker API key, may not perform the action.

values.name: STEP_UP_REQUIRED
values.doc:
The action needs a fresh step-up proof of the acting member in the
 X-Auth-Step-Up header, and none was sent or it was already used or
 expired. Complete an MFA challenge for fresh step-up and repeat the
 request with the new proof.

values.name: VAULT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The broker has no affiliate vault with this ID.

values.name: KEY_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The broker has no API key with this ID, or it no longer works.

values.name: KEY_LIMIT
values.doc: The broker would have more than two working API keys. Revoke one first.

values.name: LAST_KEY
values.doc:
The key is the broker's last key that works without an expiry; create
 another key first.

values.name: MEMBER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc:
The person is not a member of the broker and has no pending invite, or
 the account does not exist.

values.name: ALREADY_MEMBER
values.doc: The person is already a member of the broker.

values.name: OWNER_IMMUTABLE
values.doc:
The Owner cannot be removed or given another role; transfer ownership
 instead.

values.name: INVITE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No pending invite with this ID is addressed to the caller.

values.name: FEES_INVALID
values.doc:
The fees are not valid: more than three affiliates, an affiliate without
 a valid account_id or with bps outside 1 to 300, a vault named twice, or
 broker_bps and the affiliates' bps totalling more than 300.

values.name: STATS_INCOMPLETE
values.doc:
The broker stats cannot be read: a QuickSwap in the window, named by
 ErrorDetail.swap_id, is missing a record they need. Contact Polyester
 broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: ADDRESS_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The QuickSwap (swap_id in the error) cannot be issued a deposit address
 and never gets one, so nothing can be deposited to it; it is EXPIRED with
 reason DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT. Create a new QuickSwap with a new
 idempotency key, and report the swap_id to Polyester broker support.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_TAKEN
values.doc: The referral code is another partner's current code.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_RESERVED
values.doc:
The referral code is reserved: a brand or broker name, or a code a
 partner used before. Codes are never reused.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_INVALID
values.doc:
The referral code is not 4 to 16 letters, digits and hyphens, starting
 and ending with a letter or digit, without two hyphens in a row.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: The caller has not enrolled as a referral partner.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_EXISTS
values.doc:
The caller is already a referral partner with another earnings
 sub-account or display name.

values.name: EARNINGS_ACCOUNT_INVALID
values.doc:
The earnings sub-account is not an active sub-account of the caller, or
 another referral partner already uses it.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_DISABLED
values.doc: The referral partner is disabled; its code cannot be changed.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_LIMIT
values.doc:
The referral partner has used all its referral codes: a partner holds at
 most 10 codes over its lifetime, the one it enrolled with included, and
 each change retires a code for good. Its current code stays.

values.name: REFERRAL_NOT_SUPPORTED
values.doc:
The request has a referral_code, but the broker has no referral program.
 Repeat it without the code.

values.name: REFERRAL_CODE_UNKNOWN
values.doc:
The referral_code is not a referral partner's current code: unknown, or
 replaced by the partner. Repeat the request without the code.

values.name: REFERRAL_PARTNER_INACTIVE
values.doc:
The referral_code's partner is not active: not yet approved, disabled, or
 without an account its commission can be credited to. Repeat the
 request without the code.

values.name: PAYOUT_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: No payout run of the broker's vaults has this ID.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to QuickSwap errors. ConnectRPC clients receive it
 as an error detail of type swap.quickswap.v1.ErrorDetail. REST clients
 receive an application/problem+json body {type, title, status, detail,
 code, swapId, minDepositAmount, maxDepositAmount} whose code is the
 ErrorCode name, or the status name (for example INVALID_ARGUMENT) when no
 ErrorCode applies; swapId and the limits appear only when set.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc:
QuickSwap bound to the request's idempotency key, when one exists: for
 example the original QuickSwap on IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, or the QuickSwap
 whose deposit address could not be allocated.

fields.name: min_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the smallest deposit that currently quotes on
 the route with the requested protection, in source token units, whatever
 the request's basis. It moves with prices and network fees; show it as
 guidance, not a guarantee. A deposit below QuickSwapQuote.min_deposit_amount
 is returned to return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). Unset for other
 codes and when no deposit currently quotes.

fields.name: max_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
AMOUNT_OUT_OF_RANGE only: the largest deposit that quotes, in source token
 units. Unset for other codes, when no deposit currently quotes, and for a
 bridge, whose deposit no order book bounds.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Execution
types.doc: Execution selects how the credited deposit is traded.

fields.name: market
fields.doc: Execute immediately.

fields.name: twap
fields.doc: Execute in equal time slices.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionProgress
types.doc: ExecutionProgress is the trading progress of a QuickSwap.

fields.name: input_amount
fields.doc: Credited amount committed to execution, in source token units.

fields.name: executed_input
fields.doc:
Source amount traded so far, in source token units. On a two-leg route
 this counts the first leg. Zero for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: output_amount
fields.doc:
Destination amount acquired so far after service, broker and affiliate
 fees and before withdrawal network fees, in destination token units. Zero for a
 bridge: its destination withdrawal pays the credit less its fees.

fields.name: intermediate_remainder
fields.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate asset acquired but not yet converted, in
 the refund route's token units; unset for a direct route and a bridge.

fields.name: completed_slices
fields.doc:
Completed slices: a market execution's one slice completes when
 execution finishes; a TWAP slice completes once it has traded and is
 over, so a slot that traded nothing or was skipped never completes.
 Zero for a bridge.

fields.name: total_slices
fields.doc:
Planned slices: a market execution has one once it is planned; a TWAP
 has its slice count, duration_ms over slice_interval_ms rounded up. Zero
 until then, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: started_at
fields.doc: When execution started.

fields.name: deadline
fields.doc:
Execution deadline: started_at plus the TWAP duration, or plus the market
 execution window. Funds not converted by then are refunded or returned.
 Independent of the quote validity and the funding window. Unset until
 the execution is planned, and for a bridge, which trades nothing.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When execution finished; unset while executing.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.FeeKind
types.doc: FeeKind identifies one component of a QuickSwap's fees.

values.name: SERVICE
values.doc:
Service fee of one trading leg: the leg's pair fee in basis points of
 what the leg receives. A two-leg route has one per leg. On a bridge, the
 one bridge fee in basis points of the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: BROKER
values.doc:
Broker fee of one trading leg, the request's broker_bps of what the leg
 receives, credited to the broker's default vault. A two-leg route has one
 per leg; a bridge has one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: AFFILIATE
values.doc:
Affiliate fee of one trading leg, one affiliate's bps of what the leg
 receives, credited to that affiliate vault. Each affiliate has one per
 leg; on a bridge one, on the credited amount, charged at payout.

values.name: DEPOSIT_NETWORK
values.doc:
Network fee withheld from the deposit before it is credited. A quote
 shows an estimate; the fee withheld is the network's fee when the
 deposit arrives.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_NETWORK
values.doc:
Estimated network fee for a withdrawal. The actual fee is charged at
 withdrawal time and reported on the withdrawal.

values.name: REFERRAL
values.doc:
Referral commission of one trading leg: the referral partner's
 commission_bps (ReferralPricing) of what the leg receives, credited to
 the partner. It comes out of the broker fee and adds nothing to what the
 end user pays. Only a request with a referral_code has one; it never
 appears with AFFILIATE fees. On a bridge one, on the credited amount,
 charged at payout.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.FeeSplit
types.doc:
FeeSplit is the fees charged in one asset, by who they credit. Every
 amount is set, zero included.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset charged, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: service_fee
fields.doc: Service fees, credited to Polyester, in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: broker_fee
fields.doc:
Broker fees, credited to the broker's default vault, in base units of
 18 decimals.

fields.name: affiliate_fee
fields.doc:
Affiliate fees, credited to the broker's affiliate vaults, in base
 units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: referral_fee
fields.doc:
Referral commissions, credited to referral partners rather than to a
 vault of the broker, in base units of 18 decimals.

types.doc: FeeTotal is the fees charged in one group and asset.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc: BY_VAULT: public sub-account ID of the credited vault; zero otherwise.

fields.name: period_start
fields.doc: BY_DAY or BY_MONTH: start of the UTC day or month; unset for BY_VAULT.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Total credited, in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: swap_count
fields.doc: QuickSwaps that were charged a fee in this group and asset.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ListPayoutsRequest
types.doc:
ListPayoutsRequest lists the payout runs of the broker's vaults, newest
 first. Every filter narrows the list.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc:
Only this vault's payouts: the default vault or an affiliate vault, as
 a public sub-account ID. Zero for every vault of the broker.

fields.name: statuses
fields.doc:
Only payouts in one of these statuses, at most 6; empty for every
 status.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc: Only runs scheduled at or after start_time; unset for no lower bound.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Only runs scheduled before end_time (exclusive); unset for no upper
 bound.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of payouts to return; 0 means 50, at most 100.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous next_page_token, exclusive, bound
 to the broker, the filters and the list order. Reuse it with the same
 filters; limit may change. Empty for the first page.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ListPayoutsResponse
types.doc:
ListPayoutsResponse lists payouts newest first by scheduled slot. Runs of
 the same slot follow a stable server-defined order, the same on every
 page; it does not follow run_id. Paging lists exactly once every run that
 sorts after the previous page's last run when the next page is read,
 including a run started meanwhile for an older slot. A run started
 meanwhile for a newer slot sorts before the cursor and appears only in a
 listing started again from the first page.

fields.name: payouts
fields.doc: The payouts.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Cursor of the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

 optional filters. Every filter narrows the list.

fields.name: broker

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc:
Only QuickSwaps whose fees credit this vault: an affiliate vault they

 partner's commission credits no vault of the broker. Zero for every
 QuickSwap.

fields.name: statuses
fields.doc:
Only QuickSwaps in one of these statuses, at most 16; empty for every
 status.

fields.name: start_time
fields.doc:
Only QuickSwaps created at or after start_time; unset for no lower
 bound.

fields.name: end_time
fields.doc:
Only QuickSwaps created before end_time (exclusive); unset for no upper
 bound.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Maximum number of QuickSwaps to return; 0 means 100, at most 200.

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous next_page_token, exclusive, bound

 filters. Empty for the first page.

 one is listed exactly once.

fields.name: quick_swaps

fields.name: next_page_token

fields.name: statuses

 from later pages, even if its created_at is earlier than theirs.

fields.name: next_page_token
