fields.doc: What the run came to.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Machine-readable reason of the status (see PayoutStatus); empty for
 PAYOUT_PAID and PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS.

fields.name: stage
fields.doc: Where an in-progress run stands; PAYOUT_STAGE_UNSPECIFIED otherwise.

fields.name: rule_version
fields.doc: The rule version the run executed.

fields.name: scheduled_for
fields.doc: The scheduled UTC slot the run belongs to.

fields.name: started_at
fields.doc: When the run started.

fields.name: finished_at
fields.doc: When the run ended; unset while it is in progress.

fields.name: min_usd_value
fields.doc:
The rule's least USD value of one payout, in base units of 18 decimals;
 unset when the rule has no USD minimum.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc:
One step per destination of the rule version, in asset_id order. Empty
 while the run is planning.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutRuleDestination
types.doc:
PayoutRuleDestination pays one asset of a vault, in kind, to one address.
 Amounts are in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset paid, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: Destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Canonical destination address.

fields.name: min_amount
fields.doc: A run pays the asset only when the payable amount reaches this minimum.

fields.name: max_amount
fields.doc: The most one run pays the asset; the rest stays in the vault.

fields.name: min_floor
fields.doc:
The least one payout to this destination can pay now: the network's
 withdrawal minimum, and more than its current network fee. It follows
 the network fee. Unset when the network or its fee is not known now.

fields.name: estimated_network_fee
fields.doc:
The network fee a payout to this destination is expected to be charged,
 from the network's latest sampled fee: an estimate, not the fee charged
 (PayoutStep.charged_network_fee). Unset when it is not known now.

fields.name: estimated_network_fee_sampled_at
fields.doc: When estimated_network_fee was sampled; unset with it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStage
types.doc: PayoutStage is where an in-progress payout run stands.

values.name: STAGE_PLANNING
values.doc: Reading the vault's balances to size the payouts.

values.name: STAGE_REQUESTING
values.doc: A payout is waiting to be requested or being requested.

values.name: STAGE_PROCESSING
values.doc:
Every payout due was accepted; no destination-network transaction is
 known yet.

values.name: STAGE_BROADCAST
values.doc:
A destination-network transaction is known (PayoutStep.tx_hash); the run
 waits for its withdrawals to complete.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStatus
types.doc:
PayoutStatus is what one payout run of a broker vault came to, from the
 run and the outcome of each of its assets.

values.name: PAYOUT_PAID
values.doc:
The run paid: every asset with a payable amount was withdrawn and its
 withdrawal completed on its destination network.

values.name: PAYOUT_PARTIALLY_PAID
values.doc:
Some assets were paid and at least one failed; reason is the first
 failed asset's, and each step shows its own outcome.

values.name: PAYOUT_IN_PROGRESS
values.doc: The run is under way; stage says where.

values.name: PAYOUT_ROLLED_OVER
values.doc:
Nothing was paid, and the balance stays in the vault for the next run.
 reason is nothing_to_pay (no asset reached its minimum), below_minimum
 (an amount was below the least a withdrawal on its network pays),
 price_unavailable (the rule has a USD minimum and no current price
 valued an asset) or destination_cooling_down (the destination was added
 to the vault's external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago). Each
 step carries the balance evaluated, its value and the minimum it was
 held to.

values.name: PAYOUT_HELD
values.doc:
Nothing was paid because the rule stopped paying, and the balance stays
 in the vault. reason is rule_superseded (the rule was paused, changed or
 replaced before the run paid), or destination_not_whitelisted,
 destination_invalid or authority_revoked, with which the rule paused
 itself (see VaultPayoutRule.pause); an Owner or Finance member resumes
 it.

values.name: PAYOUT_FAILED
values.doc:
Nothing was paid, and at least one asset's payout failed; reason is the
 first failure's: withdrawal_refused (refused before any funds left the
 vault), gateway_capacity_insufficient (the funds stay for a later run),
 withdrawal_released (released before it was sent; nothing left the
 vault) or withdrawal_failed (the withdrawal ended without paying, before
 or after it reached the destination network). Where the funds of a
 withdrawal_failed payout are now is not shown yet. The step's tx_hash,
 when set, is its destination-network transaction.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStep
types.doc:
PayoutStep is one asset's payout in a run. Amounts are in base units of 18
 decimals.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset paid, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc: Destination chain identifier.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc: Canonical destination address.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Where the payout stands.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Machine-readable reason of a skipped or failed step: below_minimum,
 price_unavailable, rule_superseded, destination_not_whitelisted,
 destination_cooling_down (the destination was added to the vault's
 external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago; the balance stays
 for a later run), destination_invalid, authority_revoked,
 withdrawal_refused,
 gateway_capacity_insufficient, withdrawal_released (the withdrawal was
 released before it was sent; nothing left the vault) or
 withdrawal_failed (the withdrawal ended without paying; see
 PAYOUT_FAILED); empty otherwise.

fields.name: available
fields.doc: The vault's available balance of the asset when the run started.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
What the step pays: the available balance up to the rule's per-run
 ceiling, rounded down to whole units of the destination network. Zero
 when skipped. The network fee is taken out of it on the way.

fields.name: minimum
fields.doc:
The least amount the rule pays for the asset (the destination's minimum
 in the rule version the run executed). A withdrawal on the network may
 need more, as below_minimum says.

fields.name: value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of the payable amount when the run started, checked against
 Payout.min_usd_value; unset when the rule has no USD minimum or no
 current price valued the asset.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc: Destination-network transaction hash, once known.

fields.name: charged_network_fee
fields.doc:
The network fee charged on the withdrawal. On a completed step it was
 taken out of amount, so the destination received amount minus this fee.
 On a failed step whose withdrawal the destination network's bridge
 rejected or failed to execute, it is the fee kept, which is not
 refunded. Unset until the step is final, on a skipped step or one that
 failed before reaching that bridge, and when the fee was not reported;
 never zero for unknown.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.PayoutStepState
types.doc: PayoutStepState is where one asset's payout in a run stands.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_PENDING
values.doc: Planned; not yet requested.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_REQUESTING
values.doc: Being requested.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_SUBMITTED
values.doc:
The withdrawal was accepted and waits to complete on its destination
 network.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_COMPLETED
values.doc: The withdrawal completed on its destination network.

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_FAILED
values.doc: The payout failed; reason says why (see PAYOUT_FAILED).

values.name: PAYOUT_STEP_SKIPPED
values.doc:
Nothing was paid for this asset in this run; reason says why, and the
 balance stays in the vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Protection
types.doc:
Protection bounds the worst execution the end user accepts. It is fixed when
 the QuickSwap is created and is enforced on every execution, however long
 after the quote the deposit arrives.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc:
Maximum shortfall from the quoted expected output in basis points
 (1 bp = 0.01%), from 1 to 1000. Converted at creation into the quote's
 min_amount_out and min_rate.

fields.name: min_amount_out
fields.doc:
Positive minimum destination amount after fees for the quoted deposit
 amount, in destination token units. Converted at creation into the
 quote's min_rate.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwap
types.doc:
QuickSwap is one broker-owned swap of an external deposit into external
 withdrawals. The end user needs no account.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Public QuickSwap identifier.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: The broker's idempotency key that created this QuickSwap.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc:
Why the status is notable (held, returning, delayed, terminal without
 destination output); REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise. When a payout
 completes but a refund or return was NOT_SENT, the status follows the
 paid withdrawals (for example COMPLETED) and the reason is
 REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM. A FAILED withdrawal takes precedence: the status is
 HELD and the reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc:
True when status is terminal; authoritative, including for status values
 added later. Polling can stop at a terminal status. A terminal status
 never changes. Shortly after it, address_retires_at can still move later,
 and withdrawal details can be corrected as documented on Withdrawal;
 another deposit reaching the address also shows as RETURN_ONLY, and
 another deposit observed on an already retired address shows as
 MANUAL_RECOVERY. Returns made directly for such deposits are not yet
 reported in withdrawals; RETURN_ONLY does not confirm a completed return.
 Read again if the end user reports such a deposit or needs the final
 retirement time.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Accepted economic terms.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Recipient of the swap output on the destination network. Addresses and
 memos are in their network's canonical form (for example lowercase EVM
 hex), which can differ in case or encoding from the create request; that
 form is the one paid.

fields.name: destination_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for destination_address; empty when none.

fields.name: return_address
fields.doc: Recipient of returned source funds on the source network.

fields.name: return_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for return_address; empty when none.

fields.name: refund_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Refund route (asset and network) of the intermediate asset; zero when
 none was supplied.

fields.name: refund_address
fields.doc: Recipient of refunded intermediate asset; empty when none was supplied.

fields.name: refund_memo
fields.doc: Destination tag or memo for refund_address; empty when none.

fields.name: quote
fields.doc:
Quote and protection fixed at creation. Not refreshed on retries. Its
 amounts and fees stay estimates: the QuickSwap is priced when its deposit
 is credited, and execution, withdrawals and charged_fees report the
 actual output and fees.

fields.name: deposit_instructions
fields.doc:
Where and until when to deposit; absent while ALLOCATING and on a
 QuickSwap that never got an address (EXPIRED with
 DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).

fields.name: screening
fields.doc: Risk screening.

fields.name: deposits
fields.doc: Detected deposits, oldest first, at most 50.

fields.name: deposits_truncated
fields.doc:
True when more than 50 deposits were detected; only the first 50 are
 listed.

fields.name: execution
fields.doc: Execution progress; absent before execution starts.

fields.name: withdrawals
fields.doc: Withdrawals, oldest first, at most 50.

fields.name: withdrawals_truncated
fields.doc: True when more than 50 withdrawals exist; only the first 50 are listed.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap last changed.

fields.name: terminal_at
fields.doc: When status became terminal; unset while not terminal.

fields.name: version
fee_schedule_version
fields.doc:
Fee schedule version fixed at creation. Every execution or bridge payout
 of this QuickSwap is charged that version's service fees, whatever later
 versions change.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation. With a
 referral (quote.referral), the broker fee charged is broker_bps less the
 referral's discount and commission.

fields.name: charged_fees
fields.doc:
Broker and affiliate fees charged so far, as settled: one entry per fee
 kind, credited vault and asset, in kind, then account_id, then asset_id
 order. Grows while the QuickSwap executes or pays out a bridge. Each is
 the requested rate applied to the actual execution, so it can differ
 from the quote's fee lines.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapBrokerServiceGetQuickSwapRequest
types.doc: QuickSwapBrokerServiceGetQuickSwapRequest reads one QuickSwap belonging to this broker.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc:
Public QuickSwap ID. Another broker's swap is indistinguishable from an
 unknown ID.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapBrokerServiceGetQuickSwapResponse
types.doc: QuickSwapBrokerServiceGetQuickSwapResponse carries the broker's full swap detail.

fields.name: quick_swap
fields.doc: The broker-owned QuickSwap, including its quote, addresses, progress and fees.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapQuote
types.doc:
QuickSwapQuote is the priced view of a QuickSwap's terms. Prices, amounts
 and fees are estimates at quoted_at; only the protection fields are
 guarantees. A QuickSwap is priced when its deposit is credited, which can
 be hours or days after the quote: the deposit must be detected before
 DepositInstructions.funding_expires_at, and its confirmation, credit and
 execution can finish later. Its actual output and fees can therefore
 differ from the quote.

 The end user may deposit any amount from min_deposit_amount to
 max_deposit_amount. min_amount_out applies only to a deposit of exactly
 deposit_amount that fully converts; for any other deposit the guarantee is
 min_rate on the converted part.

 The credit is the deposit less the deposit network fee. Every amount below
 is in token units of its route.

fields.name: deposit_amount
fields.doc:
Source amount the quote was computed for, in source token units. Equals
 the request amount for SOURCE_AMOUNT; computed for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

fields.name: expected_amount_out
fields.doc:
Expected destination amount for deposit_amount at quoted_at, after
 trading fees and both quoted network fees, in destination token units. An
 estimate, not a guarantee: the delivered amount follows the actual
 deposit, execution and fees, bounded below only by the protection.

fields.name: min_amount_out
fields.doc:
Guaranteed minimum delivered amount, in destination token units, at the
 quoted network fees, for a deposit of exactly deposit_amount that fully
 converts to the destination asset. For any other deposit, and for a
 deposit only partly converted, the guarantee is min_rate on the converted
 part.

fields.name: min_rate
fields.doc:
Guaranteed minimum execution rate: destination display units per source
 display unit, as a decimal string with at most 18 fractional digits,
 rounded up when quoted. Guarantee: for the source amount converted all the
 way to the destination asset, the destination output before the
 withdrawal network fee is at least that amount × min_rate, rounded down to
 destination token units. On a two-leg route, the source amount converted
 is the first leg's input in proportion to the intermediate funds the
 second leg converted. Source that is not traded is returned to
 return_address, and intermediate funds that the second leg does not
 convert are refunded in the intermediate asset to refund_address; those
 parts are outside the destination guarantee. The amount delivered is the
 output less the actual withdrawal network fee, which can differ from the
 quote.

fields.name: min_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
Published minimum deposit, in source token units, compared with the
 deposit before its network fee. A smaller deposit is returned to
 return_address (DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM). It is never below the source
 network's minimum
 (AssetChainVariant.deposit_min_amount in the config), and differs from
 ErrorDetail.min_deposit_amount, the smallest deposit that currently
 quotes. For a TWAP it is the slice count times the smallest deposit one
 slice takes, and at least a market execution's minimum.

fields.name: max_deposit_amount
fields.doc:
Largest deposit that is eligible to execute, in source token units,
 compared with the deposit before its network fee. Fixed when the
 QuickSwap is created. A larger deposit is returned to return_address
 (DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM). Unset for a bridge, whose deposit no order book
 bounds.

fields.name: intermediate_asset_id
fields.doc:
Unified asset ID of the intermediate asset of a two-leg route (for
 example USDT for BTC to SOL): the AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. Zero for a direct route or a
 bridge. When non-zero, CreateQuickSwap requires a refund address for that
 asset. The route is fixed at creation.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Estimated fee components for deposit_amount at quoted_at: each leg's
 service, broker and affiliate or referral fees, in that order, legs in
 route order (a bridge has one set, charged at payout), then network fees.
 Affiliates are in ascending account_id order. Zero fees are omitted. The fees charged
 are each rate applied to the actual execution and can differ from these
 amounts; QuickSwap.charged_fees reports the broker and affiliate fees as
 charged.

fields.name: quoted_at
fields.doc: When the quote was priced.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.doc:
End of the short quote validity, typically seconds to minutes after
 quoted_at. Display the quote until expires_at. CreateQuickSwap prices the
 terms again and never fails because a quote expired. After it the price
 fields are stale; the protection of a created QuickSwap still applies.
 Independent of the funding window and the execution deadline.

fields.name: referral
fields.doc:
The referral applied; set only when the request carried a
 referral_code. A QuickSwap's quote keeps the referral fixed at creation:
 later changes to the referral program or partner never change it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapReason
types.doc: QuickSwapReason explains a notable status or deposit disposition.

values.name: SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED
values.doc:
The deposit's risk screen failed with a return verdict; the deposit is
 not accepted and is returned to return_address.

values.name: CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc:
The deposit arrived and is safe, but processing capacity is temporarily
 unavailable. Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; no
 action is needed.

values.name: PROTECTION_NOT_MET
values.doc:
Execution could not meet the protection; untraded funds are refunded or
 returned. When no protected order could be placed for the deposit, nothing
 is traded: the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap
 shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.

values.name: EXECUTION_DEADLINE_REACHED
values.doc:
The execution deadline passed before all input executed; untraded funds
 are refunded or returned. Shown while EXECUTING once the deadline ended
 trading, and on the payout statuses that follow.

values.name: LATE_DEPOSIT
values.doc: The deposit was first seen after funding_expires_at.

values.name: DEPOSIT_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc:
The deposit is below the published min_deposit_amount, or its credit after
 the deposit network fee is below the smallest order the route's market
 accepts. It is not executed: it is returned to return_address, and the
 QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason. A deposit that
 cannot be returned on the network it was received on is held (HELD with
 this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the
 swap_id.

values.name: DEPOSIT_ABOVE_MAXIMUM
values.doc:
The deposit is above max_deposit_amount, or above the largest order the
 route's market accepts. It is not executed: it is returned to
 return_address, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED with this
 reason.

values.name: WRONG_ASSET
values.doc:
The deposit is not the quoted source asset or network. It is not
 executed: it is returned to return_address on the network and in the
 asset it was received in, and the QuickSwap shows RETURNING and RETURNED
 with this reason. A deposit that cannot be returned there, such as one
 received on a network where return_address is not valid, is held (HELD
 with this reason); the broker contacts Polyester broker support with the
 swap_id.

values.name: FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED
values.doc: The funding window ended without an eligible deposit.

values.name: WITHDRAWAL_FAILED
values.doc:
A withdrawal cannot be completed and is held for review. The broker
 contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: OUTCOME_RECONCILING
values.doc:
A processing step is being confirmed. Processing resumes automatically; no
 action is needed.

values.name: SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED
values.doc:
Polyester's deposit screening blocked the deposit. It is held for
 compliance review (HELD); it is never executed or returned automatically.
 The broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id. If
 Zipper's compliance team later transfers the funds out to an address of
 its choosing, not necessarily the user's, the QuickSwap ends CLOSED with
 this reason; the funds were not returned to return_address.

values.name: REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc:
Refund not possible: an amount left to refund or return was below the
 withdrawal minimum of its asset and network, so no withdrawal was made
 for it. Its withdrawal is NOT_SENT with the amount in unsent_amount.
 Other withdrawals are unaffected.

values.name: DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT
values.doc:
The QuickSwap could not be issued a deposit address and never gets one:
 it is EXPIRED without deposit_instructions, and nothing can be deposited
 to it. Create a new QuickSwap with a new idempotency key, and report the
 swap_id to Polyester broker support.

values.name: DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_ALREADY_USED
values.doc:
The address already accepted its one eligible deposit; this deposit is
 returned to return_address and never executes.

values.name: DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_RETIRED
values.doc:
The address was retired when this deposit was observed. The deposit is
 MANUAL_RECOVERY: it never executes, is not returned automatically, and is
 potentially unrecoverable.

values.name: DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_NOT_ISSUED
values.doc: The address had not been issued when this deposit was observed; it never executes.

values.name: INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc:
On a two-leg route, intermediate funds were below the smallest order the
 second leg's market accepts, so they could not be converted to the
 destination asset; they are refunded to refund_address. Shown on the
 payout statuses that follow.

values.name: MARKET_CLOSED
values.doc:
A market on the route was halted, restricted or delisted when the deposit
 was credited and did not reopen within a bounded wait after the deposit
 was credited, the same for market and TWAP execution. Nothing was traded:
 the deposit is returned to return_address, and the QuickSwap shows
 RETURNING and RETURNED with this reason.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapStatus
types.doc:
QuickSwapStatus is the current state of a QuickSwap. While funds progress,
 the status names the earliest gate still outstanding; gates that complete
 concurrently are not reported separately.

 Flow: ALLOCATING → AWAITING_DEPOSIT → (WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY |
 PREPARING_DEPOSIT | CONFIRMING) → CREDITED → EXECUTING (skipped for a
 bridge) → PAYING_OUT | REFUNDING | RETURNING → a terminal status. A
 QuickSwap that cannot be issued a deposit address goes from ALLOCATING
 straight to EXPIRED (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT). HELD can be entered from
 any non-terminal status and is not terminal; a QuickSwap HELD with
 SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED can end CLOSED. The terminal statuses are
 COMPLETED, REFUNDED, RETURNED, EXPIRED and CLOSED; a terminal status never
 changes. Accept status values added later; is_terminal is authoritative.

values.name: ALLOCATING
values.doc:
The quote is fixed and the deposit address is being allocated. After
 ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE, allocation continues automatically until an address
 frees up; the wait has no fixed bound.

values.name: AWAITING_DEPOSIT
values.doc:
Quote and deposit address allocated; waiting for the first eligible
 deposit before funding_expires_at.

values.name: WAITING_FOR_CAPACITY
values.doc:
An eligible deposit arrived and is safe; waiting for processing capacity.
 Processing resumes automatically when capacity frees up; the wait has no
 fixed bound.

values.name: PREPARING_DEPOSIT
values.doc: The deposit is being prepared for credit. Retries keep this status.

values.name: CONFIRMING
values.doc: Waiting for source confirmations and deposit validation before credit.

values.name: CREDITED
values.doc: The deposit is credited; execution is starting.

values.name: EXECUTING
values.doc: The credited deposit is being traded.

values.name: PAYING_OUT
values.doc:
Execution finished with destination output; withdrawals, including any
 partial refund or return, are in progress.

values.name: REFUNDING
values.doc:
A two-leg route produced no destination output; the intermediate asset is
 being refunded to refund_address.

values.name: RETURNING
values.doc:
Nothing was traded or the deposit was not accepted; the source funds are
 being returned to return_address.

values.name: HELD
values.doc:
Funds are held for review. Not terminal: review resumes the QuickSwap or
 returns the funds, or, for SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED, the QuickSwap can
 end CLOSED. reason says why when a specific reason applies, else
 it is REASON_UNSPECIFIED. The broker contacts Polyester broker support
 with the swap_id.

values.name: COMPLETED
values.doc:
Terminal: every withdrawal is final (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT) and at least
 one is a DESTINATION withdrawal. A DESTINATION withdrawal is never
 NOT_SENT.

values.name: REFUNDED
values.doc:
Terminal: every withdrawal is final, none is DESTINATION, and at least one
 is REFUND (FINALIZED or NOT_SENT).

values.name: RETURNED
values.doc:
Terminal: every withdrawal is final and all are RETURN (FINALIZED or
 NOT_SENT).

values.name: EXPIRED
values.doc:
Terminal: the funding window ended without an eligible deposit
 (FUNDING_WINDOW_ENDED), or the QuickSwap never got a deposit address
 (DEPOSIT_ADDRESS_CONFLICT).

values.name: CLOSED
values.doc:
Terminal: the deposit was blocked by its risk screen
 (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED), and Zipper's compliance team transferred the
 funds out on the deposit's network to an address of its choosing, not
 necessarily the user's. Nothing was returned to return_address or
 refunded. Its one withdrawal is that COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, FINALIZED.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapSummary
types.doc:
QuickSwapSummary is one QuickSwap in a list: its state and fees. Get it
 with QuickSwapService.GetQuickSwap for its quote, deposit and withdrawals.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Public QuickSwap identifier.

fields.name: idempotency_key
fields.doc: The broker's idempotency key that created it.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current status.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why the status is notable; REASON_UNSPECIFIED otherwise.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc: True when status is terminal.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Accepted economic terms.

fields.name: fees
fields.doc:
Broker and affiliate fees as requested, fixed at creation; unset when
 the request set none.

fields.name: charged_fees
fields.doc: Broker and affiliate fees charged so far, as settled, as on QuickSwap.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the QuickSwap last changed.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuickSwapTerms
types.doc:
QuickSwapTerms are the economic terms of one QuickSwap. The same terms are
 used to quote and to create, and are echoed unchanged on the QuickSwap.
 Source and destination are either two assets, which are traded, or one asset
 on two networks, a bridge: the deposit is credited and withdrawn to the
 destination network without a trade. Any two zipped_asset_ids from the
 config may be quoted; QuoteQuickSwap is authoritative for whether the route
 is offered.

fields.name: source_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Source asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user deposits this asset on
 this network.

fields.name: destination_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Destination asset and network: an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config. The end user receives this asset on
 this network.

fields.name: basis
fields.doc: Side of the swap that amount denominates.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Positive amount in the token units of the route selected by basis: source
 route for SOURCE_AMOUNT, destination route for DESTINATION_AMOUNT.

fields.name: protection
fields.doc: Worst execution the end user accepts.

fields.name: execution
fields.doc:
Market or TWAP execution. A bridge trades nothing and takes market only;
 TWAP on a bridge is ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteBasis
types.doc: QuoteBasis states which side of the swap the request amount denominates.

values.name: SOURCE_AMOUNT
values.doc:
amount is the source amount the end user intends to deposit, in source
 token units.

values.name: DESTINATION_AMOUNT
values.doc:
amount is the destination amount the end user wants to receive after fees,
 in destination token units. The quote reports the deposit amount needed at
 the quoted price. The delivered amount still follows the actual deposit
 and execution, bounded below by the protection.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteFee
types.doc:
QuoteFee is one fee component of a quote. Trading fees (SERVICE, BROKER,
 AFFILIATE and REFERRAL) are charged when each leg settles, in the asset that leg
 receives: the base asset on a buy, the quote asset on a sell. Each is
 computed on its own from what the leg receives and rounded down when
 charged. A bridge has no settlement; its fees are charged at payout, in
 the destination asset.

 A quoted fee is an estimate, not a fixed amount. What is fixed is the
 rate (bps): each trading fee charged is that rate applied to what the leg
 actually receives once the deposit is credited, which can be hours or days
 after the quote. The quoted amount is not a cap: the fee charged and the
 output follow the actual deposit, execution prices and rounding, so they
 can be higher or lower than quoted.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: Fee component.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset and network the fee is charged in, as a zipped_asset_id. Zero for a
 trading fee of the first leg of a two-leg route, which is charged in the
 intermediate asset (intermediate_asset_id).

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Fee in zipped_asset_id's token units; for a fee charged in the
 intermediate asset, in the intermediate asset at its trading precision
 (amount.decimals). An estimate for deposit_amount at the quoted prices,
 with trading fees rounded up; the fee charged can be higher or lower.

fields.name: bps
fields.doc:
Rate of a trading fee in basis points of what the leg receives; zero for
 a network fee. The rate, not amount, is what is charged: bps of what the
 leg actually receives.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
AFFILIATE only: public sub-account ID of the affiliate vault credited
 with the fee; zero for every other kind, REFERRAL included.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteQuickSwapRequest
types.doc:
QuoteQuickSwapRequest prices terms, with the broker and affiliate fees,
 without reserving anything.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Terms to price.

fields.name: broker_bps
fields.doc:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, charged on top of
 the service fee and credited to the broker's default vault; 0 for none.
 broker_bps and the affiliates' bps total at most 300. Fees outside these
 rules fail with FEES_INVALID.

fields.name: affiliates
fields.doc:
Affiliate fees, each charged on top and credited to its affiliate vault:
 at most three distinct vaults.

fields.name: referral_code
fields.doc:
Optional referral partner code, as CreateQuickSwapRequest.referral_code:
 at most 64 bytes.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.QuoteQuickSwapResponse
types.doc: QuoteQuickSwapResponse is an indicative quote.

fields.name: quote
fields.doc:
Indicative quote, including whether the route needs a refund address.
 Its amounts and fees are estimates. Creating a QuickSwap prices the terms
 again.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralBreakdown
types.doc:
ReferralBreakdown shows how a referred Quick Swap's fee and the partner's
 commission were worked out. Rates are in basis points of what each leg
 receives and are fixed when the Quick Swap is created; a two-leg route
 shows the sum of both legs' rates. For example, on a one-leg route with a
 30 bps fee, a 3 bps discount and a 6 bps commission, the user pays 27 bps
 and the partner earns 6 bps, 20% of the fee before the discount.

fields.name: base_fee_bps
fields.doc:
Fee rate without the referral: the Polyester service fee plus the
 broker fee before the discount.

fields.name: charged_fee_bps
fields.doc: Fee rate the user pays: base_fee_bps less discount_bps.

fields.name: discount_bps
fields.doc: Discount off the user's fee.

fields.name: commission_bps
fields.doc: Commission credited to the partner.

fields.name: basis
fields.doc: What the commission is a share of: always PRE_DISCOUNT_FEE.

fields.name: credited
fields.doc:
Commission credits, oldest first, at most 100. Their sum per asset is
 ReferredQuickSwap.commission.

fields.name: credited_truncated
fields.doc: True when more than 100 credits exist; only the first 100 are listed.

fields.name: commission_value
fields.doc:
Value of the commission credited so far in US dollars at the current
 price. Unset when nothing is credited yet or when a credited asset has
 no current price; the amounts are still returned.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCodeAvailability
types.doc: ReferralCodeAvailability says whether the caller may take a referral code.

values.name: CODE_AVAILABLE
values.doc: Free: SetReferralCode would make it the caller's code.

values.name: CODE_CURRENT
values.doc: Already the caller's current code.

values.name: CODE_TAKEN
values.doc: Another partner's current code.

values.name: CODE_RESERVED
values.doc:
Reserved: a brand or broker name, or a code a partner used before.
 Codes are never reused.

values.name: CODE_INVALID
values.doc:
Not a valid code: 4 to 16 letters, digits and hyphens, starting and
 ending with a letter or digit, without two hyphens in a row.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommission
types.doc: ReferralCommission is the commission credited to the partner in one asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount credited, in base units of 18 decimals.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommissionBasis
types.doc: ReferralCommissionBasis is what a referral commission is a share of.

values.name: PRE_DISCOUNT_FEE
values.doc:
The fee before the referred user's discount: commission_bps out of
 base_fee_bps, not out of the discounted charged_fee_bps.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCommissionValue
types.doc:
ReferralCommissionValue is the US dollar value of a Quick Swap's commission
 at a current price.

fields.name: usd
fields.doc:
Value of every credited commission at the current price of its asset,
 in USD, encoded as a non-negative base-10 decimal string without
 separators or a currency symbol, rounded down to 6 decimal places. It is
 the value now, not the value when the commission was credited.

fields.name: as_of
fields.doc: Time of the oldest price used.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralCredit
types.doc:
ReferralCredit is one commission credit of a Quick Swap: a settled trade
 of one of its legs, or its bridge payout.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset credited, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Amount credited, in base units of 18 decimals.

fields.name: accrued_at
fields.doc: When the commission was credited, rounded down to the minute.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPartner
types.doc: ReferralPartner is the caller's referral partner record.

fields.name: partner_id
fields.doc: Public partner ID.

fields.name: display_name
fields.doc: Name shown for the partner.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Status.

fields.name: earnings_subaccount_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the caller's sub-account credited with the
 commissions. It never changes.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Current referral code, lower case.

fields.name: link_path
fields.doc:
Path of the share link on Polyester's Quick Swap app: "/r/" followed by
 the code.

fields.name: program
fields.doc: Rates the partner earns on; unset while no referral program runs.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the partner enrolled.

fields.name: code_changes_remaining
fields.doc:
Code changes left. A partner holds at most 10 codes over its lifetime,
 the one it enrolled with included, because a retired code is never given
 to anyone again; at 0, SetReferralCode refuses a new code with
 REFERRAL_CODE_LIMIT.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPartnerStatus
types.doc:
ReferralPartnerStatus is where a referral partner stands. Partners are
 invite-only: Polyester reviews every enrollment.

values.name: PARTNER_PENDING
values.doc:
Enrolled and waiting for Polyester's review. The code is reserved for the
 partner but earns nothing yet.

values.name: PARTNER_ACTIVE
values.doc: Approved: Quick Swaps made with the partner's code earn the commission.

values.name: PARTNER_DISABLED
values.doc:
Disabled by Polyester: new Quick Swaps with the code earn nothing and the
 code cannot be changed. Quick Swaps already created keep their terms.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralPricing
types.doc:
ReferralPricing is the referral applied to a QuickSwap, in whole basis
 points of what each leg receives. The end user pays the service fee plus
 base_broker_bps less discount_bps; the broker fee charged is
 base_broker_bps less discount_bps and commission_bps, and the partner is
 credited commission_bps (FeeKind REFERRAL). The service fee is unchanged.
 The rates depend on the route: bridging when nothing is traded,
 stablecoin when every leg trades two stablecoins, normal otherwise.

fields.name: base_broker_bps
fields.doc: Broker fee without the referral: the request's broker_bps.

fields.name: discount_bps
fields.doc: Discount off the end user's fee.

fields.name: commission_bps
fields.doc: Commission credited to the referral partner.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralProgram
types.doc:
ReferralProgram is the referral rates of every route category. Polyester
 can change them at any time; a change applies to Quick Swaps created after
 it, and Quick Swaps already created keep their rates.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: Swaps between two assets, at least one of them not a stablecoin.

fields.name: stablecoin
fields.doc: Swaps between two stablecoins.

fields.name: bridging
fields.doc: Moves of one asset between networks.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferralRates
types.doc:
ReferralRates are the referral rates of one route category, in whole basis
 points of the swapped amount. Both come out of the broker fee; the
 Polyester service fee is never reduced.

fields.name: discount_bps
fields.doc: Taken off the referred user's fee.

fields.name: commission_bps
fields.doc: Paid to the partner.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ReferredQuickSwap
types.doc:
ReferredQuickSwap is a Quick Swap the caller referred, as its referral
 partner sees it. It carries no identity of the person who swapped and no
 account, address, memo, transaction hash or flow ID. Amounts are exact;
 every time is rounded down to the minute.

fields.name: swap_id
fields.doc: Public QuickSwap identifier.

fields.name: status
fields.doc:
Current status. Accept status values added later; is_terminal is
 authoritative.

fields.name: is_terminal
fields.doc: True when status is terminal; a terminal status never changes.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the Quick Swap was created, rounded down to the minute.

fields.name: terminal_at
fields.doc:
When status became terminal, rounded down to the minute; unset while
 not terminal.

fields.name: source_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Source asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: destination_zipped_asset_id
fields.doc:
Destination asset and network, as an AssetChainVariant.zipped_asset_id
 from GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: quoted_source_amount
fields.doc: Source amount quoted at creation, in source token units; an estimate.

fields.name: quoted_destination_amount
fields.doc:
Destination amount expected at creation, in destination token units; an
 estimate.

fields.name: source_amount
fields.doc:
Source amount received, in source token units; unset until a deposit is
 detected.

fields.name: destination_amount
fields.doc:
Destination amount delivered, in destination token units; unset until a
 destination payout completes.

fields.name: base_fee_bps
fields.doc:
Fee rate the user would pay without the referral, in basis points: the
 Polyester service fee plus the broker fee before the discount. Each
 trading leg is charged its rate on what that leg receives, so a two-leg
 route shows the sum of both legs' rates; a bridge has one rate. Fixed
 at creation.

fields.name: charged_fee_bps
fields.doc:
Fee rate the user pays, in basis points: base_fee_bps less the
 referral discount. Fixed at creation.

fields.name: commission_bps
fields.doc:
Commission rate credited to the partner, in basis points, summed over
 legs as base_fee_bps is. Fixed at creation.

fields.name: commission
fields.doc:
Commission credited so far, one entry per asset in asset_id order. Grows
 while the Quick Swap executes or pays out a bridge; empty until the
 first credit. Each credit is commission_bps applied to what its leg
 actually received, so it can differ from an estimate.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RemoveMemberRequest
types.doc:
RemoveMemberRequest removes a member, or cancels the person's pending
 invite.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the member or invited person.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RemoveMemberResponse
types.doc: RemoveMemberResponse is empty.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RequestedFees
types.doc:
RequestedFees are the broker and affiliate fees a QuickSwap request set,
 charged on top of the service fee.

fields.name: broker_bps
fields.doc:
Broker fee in basis points of what each leg receives, credited to the
 broker's default vault.

fields.name: affiliates
fields.doc: Affiliate fees, in ascending account_id order.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RespondToInviteRequest
types.doc:
RespondToInviteRequest accepts or declines a pending invite addressed to
 the caller.

fields.name: invite_id
fields.doc:
Public invite ID.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: accept
fields.doc: True to accept, false to decline.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RespondToInviteResponse
types.doc: RespondToInviteResponse returns the caller's new membership.

fields.name: membership
fields.doc: The membership; unset when the invite was declined.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RevokeKeyRequest
types.doc: RevokeKeyRequest revokes a key immediately.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Key to revoke.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RevokeKeyResponse
types.doc: RevokeKeyResponse returns the revoked key.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The key.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RotateKeyRequest
types.doc:
RotateKeyRequest replaces a key by a new one. The old key keeps working
 for the overlap, then stops.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: key_id
fields.doc: Key to rotate. A broker API key may rotate only itself.

fields.name: overlap_seconds
fields.doc:
How long the old key keeps working, in seconds, from 0 to 604800 (7
 days). Default 86400 (24 hours). 0 revokes it immediately.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.RotateKeyResponse
types.doc:
RotateKeyResponse returns the new key, its token and the old key. The token
 is shown only here and cannot be recovered.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The new key.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: Bearer token qsk_<key id>_<secret> of the new key.

fields.name: previous_key
fields.doc: The old key, with the end of its overlap.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Screening
types.doc:
Screening is the risk screening of a QuickSwap. Deposits are screened on
 arrival; the outcome shows in the status, its reason and each deposit's
 disposition and reason.

fields.name: source_wallet
fields.doc:
Source wallet supplied in the request; empty when none was supplied.
 Recorded and shown; not used to accept or reject a deposit.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetMemberRoleRequest
types.doc: SetMemberRoleRequest changes a member's role.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the member.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: role
fields.doc: New role; never OWNER.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetMemberRoleResponse
types.doc: SetMemberRoleResponse is empty.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetReferralCodeRequest
types.doc: SetReferralCodeRequest replaces the caller's referral code.

fields.name: code
fields.doc:
New code: 4 to 16 letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with
 a letter or digit, without two hyphens in a row. Letters are stored in
 lower case.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetReferralCodeResponse
types.doc: SetReferralCodeResponse returns the partner with its new code.

fields.name: partner
fields.doc: The partner.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetVaultStatusRequest
types.doc:
SetVaultStatusRequest enables or disables an affiliate vault for new
 QuickSwaps.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name. A broker API key may name only its own broker.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public sub-account ID of the vault.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

fields.name: status
fields.doc: New status.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.SetVaultStatusResponse
types.doc: SetVaultStatusResponse returns the vault.

fields.name: vault
fields.doc: The vault.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.StatsPeriod
types.doc: StatsPeriod is the UTC calendar period GetBrokerStats groups by.

values.name: DAY
values.doc: A UTC day.

values.name: MONTH
values.doc: A UTC month.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.StatusCount
types.doc: StatusCount is how many QuickSwaps are in one status.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: The status.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: QuickSwaps in it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TokenAmount
types.doc: TokenAmount is an exact token amount in the token's smallest unit.

fields.name: base_units
fields.doc:
Unsigned integer amount in the token's smallest unit (for example
 satoshis or wei), as a decimal string without sign, exponent, separators or
 leading zeros; at most 78 digits.

fields.name: decimals
fields.doc:
Token decimals: the display amount is base_units / 10^decimals. Required in
 requests, where it must equal AssetChainVariant.source_decimals (the
 token's on-chain decimals) in GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config of the
 asset the amount is in: the source asset for a SOURCE_AMOUNT amount; the
 destination asset for a DESTINATION_AMOUNT amount and for
 Protection.min_amount_out.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TransferOwnershipRequest
types.doc: TransferOwnershipRequest makes another member the Owner.

fields.name: broker
fields.doc: Broker name.

fields.name: account_id
fields.doc:
Public account ID of the member who becomes the Owner.

Public ID. ConnectRPC carries it as fixed64 (a decimal string in JSON).

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TransferOwnershipResponse
types.doc: TransferOwnershipResponse is empty.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.TwapExecution
types.doc:
TwapExecution spreads execution evenly over a duration, one slice per
 slot. Slot k starts k slice intervals after execution starts. Each slice
 trades what is left of the credited deposit over the slots left, and is
 protected by the quote's min_rate on what it trades. A slice is sent only
 within its slot: a slot missed is skipped, never sent late. On a two-leg
 route, each slice's second leg converts that slice's intermediate funds
 before the next slice. Intermediate funds below the smallest order the
 second leg's market accepts do not end the TWAP: they are added to the
 next slice's conversion, and what is still unconverted when execution
 ends is refunded to refund_address (INTERMEDIATE_BELOW_MINIMUM). Only the
 second leg's market closing ends a TWAP early. A TWAP needs a larger
 deposit than a market execution, since every slice must be a valid order
 (see QuickSwapQuote.min_deposit_amount). A bridge takes market execution
 only.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.doc:
Total execution duration in milliseconds, from 60000 (1 minute) to
 86400000 (24 hours). The duration starts when execution starts, not when
 the QuickSwap is created.

fields.name: slice_interval_ms
fields.doc:
Interval between slices in milliseconds, from 10000 (10 seconds) up to
 duration_ms. The slice count is duration_ms / slice_interval_ms, rounded
 up.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.UpcomingPayout
types.doc:
UpcomingPayout previews one vault's next payout run from its balances now.
 It plans exactly as the run does; balances, prices and fees can change
 before the run starts.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc: Public sub-account ID of the vault.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Whether the next run would pay.

fields.name: next_run_at
fields.doc:
When the next run starts: its UTC slot, or, while a due slot waits to
 start, that slot. For an hourly rule, the next hourly check. Unset when
 the vault has no rule or the rule is paused.

fields.name: rule_version
fields.doc: The rule's latest version; zero when the vault has no rule.

fields.name: pause
fields.doc: Set when the rule paused itself; a rule paused by a member has none.

fields.name: min_usd_value
fields.doc:
The rule's least USD value of one payout, in base units of 18 decimals;
 unset when the vault has no rule or the rule has no USD minimum.

fields.name: assets
fields.doc:
One entry per destination of the rule, then per other asset with a
 positive balance, in asset_id order. Empty when the vault has no rule or
 the rule is paused.

fields.name: computed_at
fields.doc: When the balances, prices and fees this preview used were read.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.UpcomingPayoutAsset
types.doc:
UpcomingPayoutAsset is what a vault's next payout run would do with one
 asset, sized from the vault's balance now. Amounts are in base units of 18
 decimals.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc:
Asset, as an AssetConfig.ledger_id from
 GET /v1/chain/deposit-withdraw/config.

fields.name: destination_chain_id
fields.doc:
Destination chain identifier; zero when the rule has no destination for
 the asset.

fields.name: destination_address
fields.doc:
Canonical destination address; empty when the rule has no destination
 for the asset.

fields.name: available
fields.doc: The vault's available balance of the asset now.

fields.name: payable
fields.doc:
What the run would pay: the available balance up to the rule's per-run
 ceiling, rounded down to whole units of the destination network, or zero
 when it holds.

fields.name: held_back
fields.doc: What would stay in the vault: available minus payable.

fields.name: hold_reason
fields.doc:
Why held_back stays, or why nothing pays: below_minimum,
 price_unavailable, no_destination (the rule pays no destination for the
 asset), destination_cooling_down (the destination was added to the
 vault's external withdraw whitelist less than 24 hours ago; see
 payable_from), above_max (the balance above the per-run ceiling stays)
 or dust (less than one whole unit of the destination network stays);
 empty when the whole balance pays.

fields.name: minimum
fields.doc:
The least one payout of the asset pays: the destination's minimum, or
 the least a withdrawal on its network pays now when that is higher.
 Unset when the rule has no destination for the asset.

fields.name: value_usd
fields.doc:
USD value of what the asset would pay before its minimums, at the
 current price as of priced_at; unset when no current price values it or
 the rule has no destination for it.

fields.name: priced_at
fields.doc: When the price behind value_usd was observed; unset with it.

fields.name: estimated_network_fee
fields.doc:
The network fee a payout to the destination is expected to be charged,
 from the network's latest sampled fee: an estimate, not the fee charged
 (PayoutStep.charged_network_fee). It is taken out of the payout. Unset
 when the rule has no destination for the asset or the fee is not known
 now.

fields.name: estimated_network_fee_sampled_at
fields.doc: When estimated_network_fee was sampled; unset with it.

fields.name: payable_from
fields.doc:
Set only while the destination is cooling down (hold_reason
 destination_cooling_down): when it can be paid, 24 hours after it was
 added to the vault's external withdraw whitelist. Unset with that hold
 reason when the time is not known yet.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.VaultAssetBalance
types.doc: VaultAssetBalance is the current posted balance in one asset.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Unified asset ID, including assets no longer enabled for new swaps.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Settled balance of the vault's Funding and Trading accounts, at 18 decimals.
 Pending credits are excluded. This is not a withdrawability guarantee.

fields.name: pending_outgoing
fields.doc:
Funds committed to pending outgoing transfers, at 18 decimals. amount
 still counts these funds and has NOT been reduced by pending_outgoing.
 amount minus pending_outgoing is the balance not yet committed to an
 outgoing transfer. This excludes order holds and is not a withdrawability guarantee.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.VaultBalance
types.doc: VaultBalance is one vault's current balance observation.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc: Public vault subaccount ID.

fields.name: assets
fields.doc: Asset balances in ascending asset_id order. Empty for an unfunded vault.

fields.name: as_of
fields.doc:
UTC time this vault's balance read completed. Vaults are read separately;
 this does not describe an atomic snapshot across vaults or pages.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.VaultPayoutRule
types.doc:
VaultPayoutRule is one broker vault's payout rule and the assets it leaves
 in the vault.

fields.name: vault_account_id
fields.doc: Public sub-account ID of the vault.

fields.name: rule_version
fields.doc:
The rule's latest version; zero when the vault has no rule, and every
 other rule field is then unset.

fields.name: enabled
fields.doc: Whether the rule runs: it runs only while enabled and without a pause.

fields.name: schedule
fields.doc: When the rule runs.

fields.name: destinations
fields.doc: One destination per paid asset, in asset_id order.

fields.name: pause
fields.doc: Set when the rule paused itself; an Owner or Finance member resumes it.

fields.name: min_usd_value
fields.doc:
Least USD value one payout of the rule pays, in base units of 18
 decimals; unset when the rule has no USD minimum.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the rule's latest version was set.

fields.name: assets_without_destination
fields.doc:
Every asset the vault holds or was ever credited in that the rule pays
 no destination for, in asset_id order; every such asset when the vault
 has no rule.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.VaultStatus
types.doc: VaultStatus says whether an affiliate vault can be named by new QuickSwaps.

values.name: VAULT_ACTIVE
values.doc: New QuickSwaps can credit the vault.

values.name: VAULT_DISABLED
values.doc:
New QuickSwaps naming the vault are refused with AFFILIATE_VAULT_UNKNOWN.
 QuickSwaps already created still credit it.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.Withdrawal
types.doc:
Withdrawal is one outgoing payment. A QuickSwap can end with several, for
 example a partial refund plus the destination payout; the best case is a
 single destination withdrawal.

fields.name: index
fields.doc:
Zero-based position in the withdrawals list. Not stable: a withdrawal's
 position can change between reads, so do not use it as an identifier.

fields.name: role
fields.doc: Why this withdrawal pays its recipient.

fields.name: deposit_index
fields.doc: Deposit whose funds this withdrawal moves.

fields.name: zipped_asset_id
fields.doc: Asset and network paid, as a zipped_asset_id.

fields.name: address
fields.doc:
Recipient address in the network's native text form. Empty on a
 COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, whose recipient Polyester does not record.

fields.name: memo
fields.doc:
Recipient destination tag or memo; empty when the network uses none,
 and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc:
Amount delivered to address after the network fee, in zipped_asset_id's
 token units; set once FINALIZED. Like tx_hash, it is the amount recorded
 for this withdrawal and can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the
 QuickSwap ends (terminal_at). Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned
 because its risk screen failed (SOURCE_SCREENING_FAILED): that return is
 sent from the deposit address and reports no delivered amount. Unset on
 a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER too.

fields.name: network_fee
fields.doc:
Actual network fee withheld from this withdrawal, in the same units; set
 once FINALIZED. Can be corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap
 ends, like amount. Unset on the RETURN of a deposit returned because its
 risk screen failed, and on a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, like amount.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Withdrawal progress.

fields.name: tx_hash
fields.doc:
Recipient-network transaction recorded for this withdrawal; empty until
 the transaction is committed on the recipient network. It can be
 corrected for up to 24 hours after the QuickSwap ends (terminal_at) and is
 not updated after that. For the authoritative, latest state of the
 transfer, read flow_id.

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.doc: When the withdrawal was submitted; unset until submitted.

fields.name: finalized_at
fields.doc: When the withdrawal became final; unset until FINALIZED.

fields.name: flow_id
fields.doc:
Public, URL-safe lifecycle flow identifier of this withdrawal, usable with
 GET /v1/chain/flows/{flow_id}; empty until the flow exists. The flow is
 the authoritative, latest state of the transfer, including a correction
 made after tx_hash, amount and network_fee stop being updated. Lifecycle
 flow amounts are 18-decimal unified units (amount_e18), not token base
 units. For the RETURN of a deposit returned because its risk screen
 failed, it is the deposit's flow (Deposit.flow_id), which ends REFUNDED
 with the return as its transaction. For a COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER, it is the
 deposit's flow too, which ends FAILED with reason
 ZIPPER_COMPLIANCE_TRANSFERRED and the transfer as its transaction.

fields.name: unsent_amount
fields.doc:
Set only when state is NOT_SENT: the amount for which no withdrawal was
 made because it was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and
 network. In zipped_asset_id's token units, rounded down to the token's
 smallest unit.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.WithdrawalRole
types.doc: WithdrawalRole is why a withdrawal pays its recipient.

values.name: DESTINATION
values.doc: Swap output to destination_address on the destination network.

values.name: REFUND
values.doc:
Untraded intermediate asset of a two-leg route, including a partial
 refund, to refund_address on the refund route's network.

values.name: RETURN
values.doc:
Source funds that were not accepted or not traded, to return_address on
 the network and in the asset they were received in: the source network,
 or for a wrong asset the network it was sent on.

values.name: COMPLIANCE_TRANSFER
values.doc:
A deposit blocked by its risk screen (SOURCE_SCREENING_BLOCKED) that
 Zipper's compliance team transferred out on the network it was received
 on, to an address of its choosing, not necessarily the user's. Not a
 return or a refund: Polyester records neither the recipient nor the
 amount, so address, memo, amount and network_fee are unset; tx_hash is
 the transfer, and flow_id the deposit's flow.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.WithdrawalState
types.doc:
WithdrawalState is the progress of one withdrawal. FINALIZED and NOT_SENT
 are final: they never change. A FAILED withdrawal never changes either, but
 it does not end the QuickSwap: while any withdrawal is FAILED, the
 QuickSwap is HELD with reason WITHDRAWAL_FAILED and the funds stay
 attributed to it until support resolves it.

values.name: QUEUED
values.doc: Approved and waiting to be submitted.

values.name: SUBMITTED
values.doc: Submitted to the recipient's network; not yet final.

values.name: FINALIZED
values.doc: Final on the recipient's network.

values.name: FAILED
values.doc:
Definitively failed. The QuickSwap is HELD (WITHDRAWAL_FAILED); the
 broker contacts Polyester broker support with the swap_id.

values.name: NOT_SENT
values.doc:
Final: no transaction was or will be made for this withdrawal, because
 its amount was below the withdrawal minimum of its asset and network
 (REFUND_BELOW_MINIMUM); unsent_amount is that amount.
